description: This file defines classes, functions, and decorators for recording, replaying, and comparing ShapeEnv events in PyTorch's FX symbolic shape system. It includes the ShapeEnvEvent class, recording and replaying mechanisms, and utilities for shape environment state comparison.

classes.name: ShapeEnvEvent
classes.description: Represents a recorded method call that mutates a ShapeEnv instance, capable of replaying the event on a given ShapeEnv.

classes.name: FakeTensorMeta
classes.description: Stores metadata for FakeTensor objects, used in shape guard production.

classes.name: NotEqualError
classes.description: Custom exception raised when two ShapeEnv states are found to be unequal during comparison.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Replays the recorded event on a provided ShapeEnv instance, handling special cases for creation and evaluation.

methods.name: is_create_fx_call_function
methods.description: Checks if the event corresponds to a create_fx_call_function operation.

methods.name: is_evaluate_expr
methods.description: Checks if the event corresponds to an evaluate_expr operation.

methods.name: is_defer_runtime_assert
methods.description: Checks if the event corresponds to a guard_or_defer_runtime_assert operation.
